rules.rule_en: Vocabulary acquisition via English-Tamil translation mapping is essential for TNPSC language sections.
Expand vocabulary by grouping words with similar prefixes (e.g., 'con-' words) to improve retention for TNPSC comprehension and synonyms/antonyms sections.
Expanding vocabulary through direct English-to-Tamil word mapping is crucial for TNPSC General English translation sections.
Vocabulary building through word-to-Tamil translation is a fundamental requirement for the TNPSC General English paper.
Expand vocabulary by identifying root words and their Tamil equivalents to improve performance in TNPSC General English translation sections.
Expanding vocabulary is essential for TNPSC General English synonym and antonym questions.
Vocabulary enrichment is essential for TNPSC English language proficiency.
Expand your vocabulary for English comprehension and synonym/antonym questions in TNPSC exams.
Idioms often require contextual translation rather than literal translation for TNPSC English proficiency.

glossary.meaning_en: put off to a later time
state that one refuses to admit
in low spirits from loss of hope
lacking a plan, purpose, or enthusiasm
a forceful and bitter verbal attack
a point in which two things differ
having or showing care in work
the feeling that someone is unworthy
regard or represent as being of little worth

Act of placing side by side

translations.en: The letter is written by her.
The barking dog woke us up.
She gave him the book yesterday.
The sun rises in the east.
He is tired, so he went to bed.
translations.ta: அவன் களைப்பாக இருந்தான், அதனால் படுக்கைக்குப் போனான்.

translations.en: Because it was raining, we stayed inside.
The girl with the blue eyes smiled.
translations.ta: நீல நிறக் கண்களை உடைய பெண் சிரித்தாள்.

translations.en: When the bell rang, the students left the classroom.
translations.ta: மணி அடித்தவுடன், மாணவர்கள் வகுப்பறையை விட்டு வெளியேறினர்.

translations.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
translations.ta: இந்த புத்தகம் அந்தப் புத்தகத்தை விட அதிக சுவாரஸ்யமானது.

translations.en: She is the tallest girl in the class.
He said that he was tired.
I went to the store and bought some milk.
translations.ta: நான் கடைக்குப் போய் கொஞ்சம் பால் வாங்கினேன்.

translations.en: They are over there. Their house is big.
translations.ta: அவர்கள் அங்கே இருக்கிறார்கள். அவர்களுடைய வீடு பெரியது.

translations.en: I saw the sea. It was beautiful to see.
translations.ta: நான் கடலைப் பார்த்தேன். பார்ப்பதற்கு அழகாக இருந்தது.

translations.en: She looked up the word in the dictionary.
At this rate you will get into hot water.
translations.ta: இதே வேகத்தில் போனால் நீ சிக்கலில் மாட்டிக்கொள்வாய்.

translations.en: We escaped by the skin of our teeth.
She broke off in the middle of her story.
The detectives searched every nook and cranny of the house for clues.
translations.ta: துப்பறியும் நபர்கள் தடயங்களுக்காக வீட்டின் ஒவ்வொரு மூலையையும் சந்து பொந்தையும் தேடினர்.

translations.en: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you really want.
translations.ta: சுற்றி வளைக்காமல், உங்களுக்கு என்ன வேண்டும் என்று நேரடியாகச் சொல்லுங்கள்.

translations.en: He was determined to win the election, by hook or by crook.
translations.ta: அவர் எப்படியாவது, நல்ல வழியிலோ கெட்ட வழியிலோ, தேர்தலில் வெற்றி பெற உறுதியாக இருந்தார்.

translations.en: There's no hard and fast rule about what you should wear to the party.
translations.ta: விருந்துக்கு என்ன அணிய வேண்டும் என்பதில் எந்த கடினமான மற்றும் இறுக்கமான விதியும் இல்லை.

translations.en: The company was accused of cutting corners on safety to reduce costs.
translations.ta: நிறுவனம் செலவுகளைக் குறைப்பதற்காகப் பாதுகாப்பில் சமரசம் செய்வதாகக் குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டது.

translations.en: She is a smart cookie; she solved the problem in no time.
translations.ta: அவள் ஒரு புத்திசாலி; அவள் பிரச்சனையைச் சீக்கிரமாகத் தீர்த்துவிட்டாள்.

translations.en: The corona virus problem is a hard nut to crack; it requires global cooperation.
translations.ta: கொரோனா வைரஸ் தீர்க்க முடியாத பிரச்சனை; இதற்கு உலகளாவிய ஒத்துழைப்பு தேவை.

translations.en: The newly appointed secretary is always in a pickle because of carelessness.
translations.ta: புதிதாக நியமிக்கப்பட்ட செயலாளர் கவனக்குறைவால் எப்போதும் ஒரு சிக்கலில் இருக்கிறார்.

notes_en:
p56: This page provides a glossary list under Chapter 1: Word Translation, containing English vocabulary terms translated into Tamil for TNPSC preparation.
p57: This page provides an extensive vocabulary list with English to Tamil translations for General English preparation, covering words from A to C.
p58: This page provides a systematic English-to-Tamil word translation list, focusing on vocabulary starting with the letters 'C', particularly words beginning with the prefix 'con-'. It is a resource for building the lexical base required for TNPSC General English examinations.
p59: This page provides an alphabetical vocabulary list (C-D) with English terms and their corresponding Tamil meanings to aid in General English language preparation for TNPSC examinations.
p60: This page provides a comprehensive alphabetical list of English vocabulary words starting with D and E, alongside their equivalent Tamil meanings. It is designed to assist TNPSC aspirants in building their translation vocabulary skills.
p61: This page provides an extensive alphabetical glossary list of English vocabulary words with their corresponding Tamil translations. It is designed to assist candidates in improving their vocabulary for TNPSC General English examinations.
p62: This page provides an extensive alphabetical glossary of English vocabulary terms translated into Tamil, specifically curated for TNPSC exam preparation. The list focuses on advanced adjectives, nouns, and verbs commonly encountered in competitive English sections.
p63: This page provides a comprehensive vocabulary list organized alphabetically, mapping English terms to their Tamil meanings. It is designed to assist TNPSC candidates in improving their General English proficiency through direct word-translation practice.
p64: This page provides an extensive vocabulary list focusing on word translations from English to Tamil. It covers a wide range of academic and descriptive terms commonly tested in TNPSC competitive exams.
p65: This page provides a glossary of English words ranging from 'P' to 'R' with their corresponding Tamil translations, useful for General English vocabulary preparation.
p66: This page provides a comprehensive vocabulary list for word-to-Tamil translation, covering common English terms from R to T, which is essential for English comprehension and vocabulary-based questions in the TNPSC General English syllabus.
p67: This page provides an alphabetically organized glossary of English words with their corresponding Tamil translations, specifically focused on enhancing vocabulary proficiency for TNPSC General English examinations.
p68: This page provides a collection of common English sentences translated into Tamil to assist with sentence translation exercises for TNPSC exams. It covers various tenses, voice transformations, and complex sentence structures.
p69: This page provides a collection of English idioms and common sentences with their appropriate Tamil translations, emphasizing natural expression over literal translation.
